paths.name: cookie-consent
paths.description: No cookies before consent, and a refusal must stick
paths._note: Rewritten 2026-08-27. This used to read 'GA must not load before consent'. That is deliberately no longer true: under Consent Mode v2 gtag.js and GTM load for every visitor with analytics_storage denied in the page head, because a tag that only appears after a button press cannot be found by Google's own checks — GA4 reported 'your Google tag wasn't detected' for as long as loading depended on a click. The requirement was always about STORAGE, not about the script, so the check is now for cookies.

steps.element: consent banner with an equal-weight decline
no cookies set before a choice is made — the Google tag loads, but analytics_storage is denied so nothing is stored

steps.do: accept, and confirm _ga cookies appear only then
decline, reload, and confirm the refusal is remembered
